tests.title: A category added to the content data appears on the category screen with no change to the screen

steps.action: Add a deck labelled "6+" to the shipped content data, registered first in the list
steps.expected: The content data holds the shipped decks and "6+"

steps.action: Open the category screen
steps.expected: Each shipped category has an entry, and a "6+" entry follows them

steps.action: Read the category screen's source
steps.expected: It names no category, so the new entry needed no change to it

tests.title: Every element on the category screen is pure black or pure white, and any other colour fails the test

steps.action: Open the app (root layout and navigation included) and read the colour of every element drawn
steps.expected: Every colour is #000000 or #FFFFFF — the navigation's screen background included

steps.action: Draw an element in a third colour (grey) and read the colours again
steps.expected: The check reports the grey: another colour fails the test

steps.action: Read every source file under `src/` except `src/theme.ts`, and the app configuration
steps.expected: No colour is written anywhere but the theme; the app configuration's colours are black or white

tests.title: Nothing on the category screen animates and no screen transition is animated

steps.action: Open the app and read the transition every screen of the navigation stack is given
steps.expected: Every screen's transition is `none`

steps.action: Give a screen an animated transition and read the transitions again
steps.expected: The check reports it: an enabled animation fails the test

steps.action: Read every source file under `src/`
steps.expected: None uses an animation API or a component that animates by itself (`Animated`, `LayoutAnimation`, Reanimated, `ActivityIndicator`, `TouchableOpacity`, `TouchableHighlight`)
